title: Black-box host contract conformance suite and the contract fixes it found
goal: Ship susi-conformance, a dependency-light black-box suite integrators run against a live host (health without token, 401 without bearer on every HTTP port, MCP 2026-07-28 discover/tools/unknown-method, MCP 2025-06-18 session flow, A2A card and -32601, GEMI models with a path-leak warning, per-check latency), and fix what it found: public /health on 9090/9093/9094 and standard JSON-RPC codes from A2A. Also stop /v1/models from advertising Windows filesystem paths as model ids. Also stop the first MCP tools/list on a fresh host from blocking on external MCP server probes (measured 10.3 s).
